definitions.explanation: An edible plant or part of a plant.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}を{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
{新鮮|しんせん}な{野菜|やさい}はおいしい。
{子供|こども}は{野菜|やさい}が{好|す}きではない。
{毎日|まいにち}{野菜|やさい}を{食|た}べると{体|からだ}にいいですよ。
examples.english: Eating vegetables every day is good for your health.

notes:
{野菜|やさい} is the general term for vegetables. It covers all edible plants used in cooking, similar in scope to English "vegetable."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {野菜|やさい}を{食|た}べる: to eat vegetables
- {野菜|やさい}を{切|き}る: to cut vegetables
- {野菜|やさい}を{育|そだ}てる: to grow vegetables
- {新鮮|しんせん}な{野菜|やさい}: fresh vegetables
- {生野菜|なまやさい}: raw vegetables

COMMON VEGETABLES:
- {人参|にんじん}: carrot
- {玉|たま}ねぎ: onion
- {大根|だいこん}: daikon radish
- {白菜|はくさい}: Chinese cabbage
- キャベツ: cabbage

COMPOUNDS:
- {野菜炒|やさいいた}め: stir-fried vegetables
- {野菜|やさい}ジュース: vegetable juice
- {根菜|こんさい}: root vegetables

NOTE:
{青物|あおもの} is an older or market-specific term for green vegetables. {果物|くだもの} (fruit) is the complementary category.
